title: List evaluation report configs
description: List all evaluation report configurations for the current project. Optionally filter by evaluation UUID using the 'evaluation' query param. Each report config controls how and when evaluation summary reports are generated and delivered (email or Slack).

methodDocumentation.text: CRUD for evaluation report configurations + report run history.

List all evaluation report configurations for the current project. Optionally filter by evaluation UUID using the 'evaluation' query param. Each report config controls how and when evaluation summary reports are generated and delivered (email or Slack).

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
How report generation is triggered. 'every_n' fires once N new evaluation results have accumulated (subject to cooldown_minutes and daily_run_cap). 'scheduled' fires on the cadence defined by rrule.

* `scheduled` - Scheduled
* `every_n` - Every N

layers.text:
How report generation is triggered. 'every_n' fires once N new evaluation results have accumulated (subject to cooldown_minutes and daily_run_cap). 'scheduled' fires on the cadence defined by rrule.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: RFC 5545 recurrence rule string for scheduled reports. Only daily and weekly cadences are supported: use 'FREQ=DAILY' or 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,FR'. Required when frequency is 'scheduled'; ignored otherwise.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Read-only anchor datetime used to expand scheduled reports. The server sets this automatically when a report is switched to scheduled mode.

layers.text: Read-only anchor datetime used to expand scheduled reports. The server sets this automatically when a report is switched to scheduled mode.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Read-only timezone used for scheduled reports. Evaluation reports use UTC.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: List of delivery targets. Each entry is either {type: 'email', value: 'user@example.com'} or {type: 'slack', integration_id: <int>, channel: '<channel>'}. Slack integration_id must belong to this team.
